title: Start a task
caption: A new conversation with a request typed into the composer. The chip under the prompt shows the computer (Gateway) the task will run on; earlier conversations are listed on the left.
alt: SMTO web UI start screen. A navigation sidebar lists earlier conversations; the main area shows the heading 'What can I help you do?' and a composer containing the request 'Find what's using disk space in ~/Downloads and summarise it' with a 'localhost' Gateway chip.

title: A completed task
caption: The model's plan and progress notes, followed by its answer: a table of the largest items and a note that nothing was changed.
alt: SMTO conversation. The request 'Find what's using disk space in ~/Downloads and summarise it' is followed by the plan 'Checking free space on the root filesystem first', the note 'Measuring the largest items in ~/Downloads' and an answer stating that ~/Downloads holds about 33 GB with 14 GB free on the root filesystem, with a table of the five largest items.

title: Activity and receipts
caption: The same task with Debug mode on. Each step shows the shell command the model chose, where it ran (Gateway and folder), its exit status and the captured output.
alt: SMTO conversation in Debug mode. An expanded activity group, 'Measuring the largest items in ~/Downloads', lists two completed shell steps, 'df -h /' and 'du -sh ./* | sort -rh | head -n 8', each with exit 0, and the du output: vm-images 18G, two Ubuntu ISO files and smaller items.

title: Approve before files change
caption: A follow-up request that moves files. The task pauses on an approval card showing the exact command, with a choice of how widely the decision applies.
alt: SMTO conversation with the request 'Move the two Ubuntu ISOs to /mnt/backup/isos, then check free space again'. An 'Approval needed' card shows the shell command 'mv -- ubuntu-24.04.1-desktop-amd64.iso ubuntu-22.04.4-desktop-amd64.iso /mnt/backup/isos/', an 'Apply decision to' selector set to 'This action', and the buttons 'Approve once', 'Deny / stop task' and 'Open Permissions'.

title: Approve before files change

alt: SMTO conversation with the request 'Move the two Ubuntu ISOs to /mnt/backup/isos, then check free space again'. An 'Approval needed' card shows the shell command 'mv -- ubuntu-24.04.1-desktop-amd64.iso ubuntu-22.04.4-desktop-amd64.iso /mnt/backup/isos/', an 'Apply decision to' selector set to 'This action', and the buttons 'Approve once', 'Deny / stop task' and 'Open Permissions'.

title: Approved change, then verification
caption: After approval the task moves the files, checks free space again and reports the before-and-after numbers from that second check.
alt: SMTO conversation with the request 'Move the two Ubuntu ISOs to /mnt/backup/isos, then check free space again'. The plan note says the move needs approval, a later note reads 'Checking free space again to confirm the result', and the answer says both ISO files were moved to /mnt/backup/isos/ and free space on / went from 14 GB to 25 GB.

title: The model asks before choosing
caption: When a choice belongs to the user, the model asks. The question card offers suggested answers and a free-text field, and the task waits for the reply.
alt: SMTO conversation with the request 'Read meeting-notes.md and save the action items to action-items.md'. After two progress notes, a question card asks how to save 4 new action items because action-items.md already lists 2, with three suggested answers (append, replace, save to a new dated file) and an 'Other answer' field.

title: Capabilities
caption: The Capabilities dialog lists the skills and tools the model may use, with include and exclude controls and an 'Apply to' scope selector.
alt: SMTO Capabilities dialog over the chat: an 'Automatic Capability Selection' switch, an 'Apply to' selector set to Global, and skills such as Artifacts, Agent Introspection, Task Context and Docs, each with include and exclude controls or marked 'Built in · Always enabled'.

title: Model routing
caption: Model routing in Settings. The Main model entry is open, showing its endpoint, automatic model selection, API key and generation profile.
alt: SMTO Settings page with the Model routing section open. The Main model entry shows the endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1, an Auto-select model switch turned on, an empty API key field and the 'smTO recommended' generation profile; a list of settings sections is on the left.

title: Gateways
caption: The Gateways section lists the computers SMTO can run tasks on, with their connection status, an on/off switch and software update status.
alt: SMTO Settings page with the Gateways section: a table with two Gateways, 'localhost' and 'LocalMachine', both Connected and enabled, and buttons to add a Gateway and check for updates.

title: Workflows
caption: Saved workflows are reusable requests. Each card can be run now, scheduled, edited or opened to see its run history.
alt: SMTO Workflows page listing three saved workflows, 'Weekly disk space report', 'Nightly backup check' and 'Meeting notes to action items', each with its prompt and buttons including Run now, Schedule, Edit and History.

title: Schedules
caption: Scheduled tasks and reminders with their recurrence, status and most recent run. Schedules can be paused, edited or run on demand.
alt: SMTO Schedules page in dark mode listing four schedules: 'Weekly disk space report', 'Nightly backup check', a paused 'Rotate old build archives' and a 'Stretch break' reminder, each with recurrence and status.

title: Built-in manual
caption: The product manual ships with SMTO and is searchable. Pages are listed on the left, with an outline and related pages on the right.
alt: SMTO Manual home page: a list of manual pages on the left including 'Install and startup' and 'Configuration and storage', the 'smTO Manual' introduction in the centre, and outline and related-page panels on the right.

title: On a phone
caption: The phone layout of the same web UI, with a request typed into the message box.
alt: SMTO on a phone-width screen: the heading 'What can I help you do?' and a message box containing 'Find what's using disk space in ~/Downloads and summarise it' with a send button.

title: Answers on a phone
caption: A completed task on a phone in dark mode: the answer, built from the commands the model ran, and a box to continue the conversation.
alt: SMTO phone layout in dark mode: an answer saying ~/Downloads holds about 33 GB with 14 GB free on /, a short list of the largest items, and a 'Continue this conversation' box.

title: Conversations on a phone
caption: The navigation drawer on a phone, with New chat, search and the list of conversations.
alt: SMTO phone navigation drawer with App and Conversations tabs, a New chat button, a 'Search chats' field and four conversations, the newest being the disk-space request.
